about: HVACDRAIN (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md): the same rough tree as a condensate network, the drain point at its left end (0,0), three units (2.8, 5.6, 7.1 kW). Spec-derived: pipes are rewritten on the template layers EIA_1 Pipe condensated DN<n>; each unit's own pipe is D27 (Daikin Si39: D27 for one unit); the pipes toward the drain are D34 or larger and never smaller than the pipes upstream; every 90 degree corner and right-angle T joint is cut with a 45 degree piece of 300 mm (212.13 on each axis) and the branch lands DOWNSTREAM of the T (nearer the drain: x 2797.87 < 3000); labels read D<size>-<slope>% (default slope 1%), height 150, tagged HVACAI_DRAINLABEL; unit pipes carry HVACAI_UNIT xdata (index, kW). [run-derived]: the D34 on both downstream pipes (the total kW table of Si39 is in DrainSizingCore; 8.4 and 15.5 kW both give D34) and the exact slant coordinates.
